items.reason: Added docs/runbooks/credential-rotation.md plus a machine-readable registry and a blocking test that fails when a credential in the threat model has no rotation procedure.

Gave scripts/agent-surface.mjs a --root override and added a drill that plants an instruction inside a generated block and requires the real gate to go red, including --accept refusing to pin it without --accept-instructions.

Added hostile-payload fault injection for the Sklik connector (malformed, partial, rate-limited, half-payload mid-sync) and for the Google daily mappers, and fixed a latent TypeError where a non-string segments.date reached localeCompare.

Needs network: pinning 53 action refs means resolving each tag to a commit SHA against the GitHub API, and scripts/actions-pin.mjs --update already does exactly that in one pass (it also flips STRICT and the P6 ratchet), so there is nothing to add offline and an invented SHA would break the workflow rather than pin it.

Already covered: .github/branch-ruleset.json is the server-side ruleset declared in the repo, npm run merge-gate fails when its contexts drift from .github/required-checks.json, and npm run protection:verify reads the live rules weekly; POSTing the ruleset to GitHub needs network and an admin token.

Already covered: scripts/commit-subject.mjs already refuses both cited subjects by name (loop-mechanics and run-progress catch 'partial work from an interrupted lane session'; first-person and session-report catch 'I've finished, here's what I did'), and scripts/commit-attribution.mjs already emits Co-Authored-By alongside the lane trailers — the residual is history plus outer harnesses that run no hooks, which AGENTS.md states has no repository-side fix.

Already covered: .github/guidance-budget.json caps the seven read-first documents at 1603 lines with a per-file ceiling, scripts/guidance-budget.mjs measures it, and test-unit/guidance-budget.test.mjs blocks on every build — this change paid for its own one-line raise of the task-index ceiling through that mechanism.

Needs platform credentials: a preview-per-change environment requires a Vercel project token and preview env wiring that does not exist in this repo, and a workflow referencing secrets nobody has set would be a file that never operates.

lessons: This repository already answers most maturity questions, so the first move on any item must be to look for the existing mechanism: three of eight dispatched gaps (guidance budget, branch-ruleset declaration, commit-subject narration rules) were fully built and the scan was reading history or an unreadable GitHub setting, not an absent practice.

Its house idiom for 'is this fence still connected?' is to give the gate script a --root/--ledger/--budget override and spawn the REAL script over a mutated fixture from a unit test. Follow that shape rather than unit-testing the gate's helper functions, which passes just as happily when the gate has been disconnected.

Adding any document here is a multi-file act by design: a runbook must land with an entry in .github/docs-staleness.json, a route in docs/task-index.md, and — because that route costs a line — a raised ceiling in .github/guidance-budget.json with the reason next to it. Budget for the wiring, not just the page.
